  "screen_rationale": "The study is a review of systematic reviews that quantifies the limitations of preclinical animal research and its translation to human clinical outcomes, discussing concordance rates and overstatement of efficacy.   "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The role of systematic reviews in identifying the limitations of preclinical animal research, 2000-2022: part 2. This review synthesizes findings from numerous systematic reviews of various animal studies.",

  "species_evidence": "Even basic information, such as the number of animals used in experiments, was found to be missing, as was reporting on attrition.11 This – the loss of animals through death or exclusion – can dramatically alter the results of a study and, again, have the effect of making animal studies appear more positive than they actually are. (referencing Holman et al. 2016 which includes rodents).",
